Biodiversity Corridor Calculator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Biodiversity Corridor Analyst skill for autonomous agents.

- Assesses landscape context by retrieving surrounding land cover and resistance data.
- Provides ecological premium values and prioritization for conservation planning.
